acceptance: The test no longer depends on a stream starting within 0.5 s, shown by 200 consecutive passes under xdist with CPU contention.
The test still fails when the executor starts no streams (mutation check).
description:
## Problem
`tests/unit/core/load_testing/test_executor.py::TestConcurrentLoadExecutorEdgeCases::test_high_concurrency` runs `SteadyPattern(concurrency=20, duration_seconds=0.5)` and asserts `max_concurrency_reached > 0`. On a busy runner no stream started before the pattern ended: trunk run 45188452490 (develop 5e784d6039, medium-test shard 0) failed with `max_concurrency_reached == 0` and turned develop red, which blocked `make pr-arm` for every PR. The six earlier trunk runs passed, and the merged change did not touch load testing. The failed job was re-run once on owner instruction and passed.

## Change
Make the assertion independent of scheduler timing: wait for streams to start, or assert the outcome the test means to pin, instead of racing a 0.5 s window.

## Decision gates
- Lengthening the pattern duration alone is not a fix; if it is part of the fix, show the owner why.
- If the executor genuinely can end a run with no stream started, that is a product defect: record it and ask the owner whether to fix the executor instead.

## Verification rubric
Pass: 200 consecutive passes under pytest-xdist with CPU contention (or an equivalent deterministic proof), and a mutation in which the executor starts no streams still fails the test.

## Guardrails
- Work in a linked worktree from `make worktree-create`; never write in the primary clone. Stage named paths only; commit as the pinned human identity with no agent attribution.
- Push only after `make pr-preflight` passes on the exact head. Never `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite authorship.
- Arm only with `make pr-arm`, once per head. A second attempt only when the refusal named a cause that is now fixed; a third needs the owner. `make pr-rerun` only for a job the runner cancelled or never ran, never to re-roll a failed test.
- Never post a stand-in review. Resolve a review thread only after the bot has reviewed the new head and did not raise the finding again.
- Heavy work only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking target. Never set `BENCHBOX_HEAVY_ADMIT=force`, `BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK` or `BENCHBOX_HEAVY_WATCHDOG=off`.
- Any new limit, threshold, default or user-facing label is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- Do not mark a test skip, xfail, quarantine or slow to make it pass.
- Report only what merged and what was verified, with run ids and heads.
